name: Combined Civil Services Examination – II (Group II and IIA Services), Notification No. 07/2026
tamilName: தமிழ்நாடு அரசுப் பணியாளர் தேர்வாணையம் – குரூப் II
summary: Group II and IIA services — Assistant Section Officer, Sub Registrar, Deputy Commercial Tax Officer, Probation Officer and related posts. Preliminary plus main written examination, no interview.
whyItMatters: Group II is the usual next step after Group IV, and its ceiling (32 for Others, 37 for reserved categories) is two years above Group IV's for general candidates — which decides eligibility for a large band of repeat aspirants.

vacancies.note: The notification prints two totals — 41 for Group II Services and 780 for Group IIA Services — and never states their sum. 821 is that sum; both figures are printed in para 3.

fee.note: ₹100 for the preliminary examination and ₹150 for the main written examination. The one-time registration fee is ₹150. Confirm in the notification.

ageRules.label: Group II and IIA posts (except Executive Officer, Grade III)

destituteWidow.note: The table prints ‘No maximum age limit’ for every post except Deputy Commercial Tax Officer, where it is 37.

ageRules.notes: This is the most misunderstood rule in the notification: for reserved categories the table says ‘No maximum age limit’ for almost every Group II post, and para 4.1.3 defines that as not having completed 60 years. The 32/37 figures apply to the general category and to the few posts with their own numbers (Deputy Commercial Tax Officer 37, or 39 with a law degree; Probation Officer minimum 22; Sub Registrar minimum 20).

citation.quote: The category wise maximum age limit and age concession details are given below.

ageRules.label: Executive Officer, Grade III (Post Code 1654)

citation.quote: For all posts (except Executive Officer, Grade III)

ageRules.notes: Executive Officer, Grade III carries a higher minimum (25) and a general ceiling of 37.

ageRules.label: Probation Officer (Post Code 1023)
ageRules.notes: Minimum age 22 rather than 18; otherwise the general ceiling of 32 applies.

qualifications.summary: A bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university is the base requirement, but several posts specify the degree: Deputy Commercial Tax Officer requires B.A., B.Sc. or B.Com.; Assistant Section Officer (Law) requires B.L.; some Assistant Section Officer posts require a master's degree. Check the post code in para 4.2 before applying.

citation.quote: A degree from any University recognised by the University Grants Commission.

qualifications.summary: Some posts name the degree: Deputy Commercial Tax Officer requires B.A., B.Sc. or B.Com.; the law post requires B.L.; some Assistant Section Officer posts require a master's degree. Check the post code in para 4.2.

citation.quote: Must possess the degree of B.A., B.Sc., or B.Com.

specialRequirements.label: Tamil language requirement
specialRequirements.detail: Candidates must have studied Tamil up to SSLC or pass the Second Class Language Test (Full Test) in Tamil conducted by TNPSC.

citation.quote: Second Class Language Test (Full Test) in Tamil
